description: Search EPA-regulated facilities by name fragment, and optionally narrow by city, state (two-letter code), ZIP code prefix, county name (requires state; official county name, case-insensitive), program (CAA, CWA, SDWA, RCRA, TRI, GHG), current compliance status, or active facilities only. Results are ordered by enforcement significance (formal actions, then penalties), and each result shows the facility's programs, compliance status, inspection count, formal action count, and total penalties. Use list_facilities_with_violations instead for a worst-first list of only the facilities currently in violation, and get_facility with a result's Registry ID for one facility's full unified profile.

program.description: Program code: CAA, CWA, SDWA, RCRA, TRI, or GHG

name: search_facilities
